title: Remembering Solomon Marcus
abstract: arXiv:2609.18224v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: From the manifest of Andre Breton, through the transdisciplinary understanding, we arrive at a post-modern manifest. A talk by Laura De Marco (Harvard) will provide scientific background to approach an AMS poetry. The next section will be a qualitative analysis of some new operations on the real numbers. The conclusions will be given in the last section, and an appendix will recall some previous work with some new comments.

translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.18224v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：从安德烈·布勒东的宣言出发，通过跨学科的理解，我们抵达一个后现代宣言。劳拉·德·马尔科（Laura De Marco，哈佛大学）的演讲将为接近美国数学学会（AMS）诗歌提供科学背景。下一节将对实数上的一些新运算进行定性分析。结论将在最后一节给出，附录将回顾以往的一些工作并附上一些新的评论。
tldr: 本文是一篇缅怀罗马尼亚数学家所罗门·马库斯的纪念文章，以布勒东宣言和跨学科理解为出发点，探讨数学与诗歌之间的联系，并对实数上的新运算进行了定性分析。
en_tdlr: A memorial tribute to mathematician Solomon Marcus that explores the interdisciplinary connection between mathematics and poetry, from Breton's manifesto to post-modern understanding, including a qualitative analysis of new operations on real numbers.
